original_object.reason: The non-stopping branch only assigns x_{k+1}; it never says to advance k and repeat or what to return then. The loop control and eventual output are unspecified.

The title names iteratively regularized Gauss–Newton, but the procedure implements unanchored Levenberg–Marquardt. Standard IRGNM adds α_k(x_0−x_k) to the normal equation’s right-hand side, producing different subsequent iterates.
